interest: Index on Dutch fears of Japanese oil concessions in Borneo.
overview: Docket (1945) on Japanese oil concessions in Dutch Borneo and 1931-32 reports of Japanese activity off North Borneo.

subfiles.about: A Department of State docket sheet listing records from 1931 to 1932 regarding Japanese oil concessions, naval base concerns, and maritime activities in Dutch and North Borneo.
subfiles.summary: Indexes 1931-32 reports on Japanese oil concessions in Dutch Borneo, feared as naval-base pretext, and activity off North Borneo.
